name: net.chinaedu.project.livesdk.core.screenshare.agora.impl.LiveAgoraScreenCapture$ScreenCaptureAssistantActivity
description: When a user starts screen sharing through Agora in ChinaEdu Live SDK, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt and returns the approval to the sharing flow.
disableEffect: Agora-based screen sharing in ChinaEdu Live SDK will not be able to obtain screen-capture approval.
